derivation_boundary: A row states the storey of a mapped tenancy when OSM carries no level tag. level 0 is the street storey; level 1 is the Japanese 2F.
Only status 'approved' with decided_by 'operator' and a verbatim decision_record is read. A proposal discharges nothing.

A tenancy above the street storey gets no street storefront; the street slot belongs to the ground-floor tenancy. Its identity stays a canonical place (minimap, labels); its upper-storey sign is representation debt until a source sign is resolved.
